<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RestaurantOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restaurant-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer handed over"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ChefOrder" name="New meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MealReady" name="Meal placed in service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Call" name="Guest called"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ArrivalAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MealHandover" name="Meal handed over"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RestaurantOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Restaurant employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Chef" name="Chef" processRef="Process_Chef"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderPlaced" sourceRef="SendTask_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Start_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuzzerHandover" sourceRef="SendTask_HandBuzzer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ChefOrder" sourceRef="SendTask_InformChef" targetRef="Start_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MealReady" sourceRef="SendTask_MealReady" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuzzerRings" sourceRef="SendTask_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CallGuest" sourceRef="SendTask_CallGuest" targetRef="Catch_CallReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ArrivalAtHatch" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportArrival" targetRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MealHandover" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOverMeal" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MealReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Hungry" name="Guest feels hungry and enters restaurant">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_G1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_BuzzerHandover" name="Receive buzzer with information" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_Buzzer" name="Buzzer or call?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CallReceived" name="Employee calls for guest">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CallReceived" messageRef="Msg_Call"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoToHatch" name="Go to service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReportArrival" name="Report arrival at service hatch" messageRef="Msg_ArrivalAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_MealReceived" name="Receive meal at service hatch" messageRef="Msg_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Guest" name="Meal eaten">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_G11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G1" sourceRef="Start_Hungry" targetRef="Task_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDish" targetRef="Task_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G3" sourceRef="Task_WaitTurn" targetRef="SendTask_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G4" sourceRef="SendTask_PlaceOrder" targetRef="ReceiveTask_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G5" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_BuzzerHandover" targetRef="EventGW_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G6" sourceRef="EventGW_Buzzer" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G7" sourceRef="EventGW_Buzzer" targetRef="Catch_CallReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G8" sourceRef="Catch_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Task_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G9" sourceRef="Catch_CallReceived" targetRef="Task_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G10" sourceRef="Task_GoToHatch" targetRef="SendTask_ReportArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G10b" sourceRef="SendTask_ReportArrival" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MealReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G10c" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_MealReceived" targetRef="Task_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G11" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="End_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Restaurant employee" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Order" name="Order placed by guest">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterOrder" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectPayment" name="Collect payment from guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_HandBuzzer" name="Hand over buzzer with information" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Msg_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_MealReady" name="Receive notice that meal is in service hatch" messageRef="Msg_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest buzzer" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_Hatch" name="Guest at hatch or timeout?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GuestAtHatch" messageRef="Msg_ArrivalAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_5Min" name="5 minutes elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_5Min">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_CallGuest" name="Call for guest" messageRef="Msg_Call"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest" messageRef="Msg_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Meal" name="Meal handed over"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E1" sourceRef="Start_Order" targetRef="Task_EnterOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E2" sourceRef="Task_EnterOrder" targetRef="Task_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E3" sourceRef="Task_CollectPayment" targetRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E4" sourceRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer" targetRef="SendTask_HandBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E5" sourceRef="SendTask_HandBuzzer" targetRef="SendTask_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E6" sourceRef="SendTask_InformChef" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E7" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_MealReady" targetRef="SendTask_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E8" sourceRef="SendTask_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="EventGW_Hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E9" sourceRef="EventGW_Hatch" targetRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E10" sourceRef="EventGW_Hatch" targetRef="Timer_5Min"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E11" sourceRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch" targetRef="SendTask_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E12" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOverMeal" targetRef="End_Meal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E13" sourceRef="Timer_5Min" targetRef="SendTask_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E14" sourceRef="SendTask_CallGuest" targetRef="EventGW_Hatch"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chef" name="Chef" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ChefOrder" name="New meal order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ChefOrder" messageRef="Msg_ChefOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInHatch" name="Place finished meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_MealReady" name="Inform employee that meal is in service hatch" messageRef="Msg_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Chef" name="Meal ready"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C1" sourceRef="Start_ChefOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_PlaceInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C3" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInHatch" targetRef="SendTask_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C4" sourceRef="SendTask_MealReady" targetRef="End_Chef"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RestaurantOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restaurant-order">

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RestaurantOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Payment given" sourceRef="Task_PayMeal" targetRef="Task_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer handed over" sourceRef="Task_HandBuzzer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ChefOrder" name="New meal order" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Start_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MealReady" name="Meal in service hatch" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployeeMealReady" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SetOffBuzzer" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CallGuest" name="Guest called" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Catch_Called"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest at hatch" sourceRef="Task_GoToHatch" targetRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch"/>

  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GuestHungry" name="Guest feels hungry and enters restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PayMeal" name="Pay for meal"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Buzzer" name="Receive buzzer with information" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_BuzzerOrCall" name="Buzzer rings or guest is called?"/>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Called" name="Employee calls for guest">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Called" messageRef="Msg_Call"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoToHatch" name="Go to service hatch"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GuestMealEaten" name="Meal eaten"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G1" sourceRef="Start_GuestHungry" targetRef="Task_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDish" targetRef="Task_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G3" sourceRef="Task_WaitTurn" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G4" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_PayMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G5" sourceRef="Task_PayMeal" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G6" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Buzzer" targetRef="EventGW_BuzzerOrCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G7" sourceRef="EventGW_BuzzerOrCall" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G8" sourceRef="EventGW_BuzzerOrCall" targetRef="Catch_Called"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G9" sourceRef="Catch_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Task_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G10" sourceRef="Catch_Called" targetRef="Task_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G11" sourceRef="Task_GoToHatch" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MealReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G12" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_MealReceived" targetRef="Task_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G13" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="End_GuestMealEaten"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Restaurant employee" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed by guest">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterOrder" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectPayment" name="Collect payment from guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandBuzzer" name="Hand over buzzer to guest with information">
      <bpmn:documentation>When the buzzer rings, your dinner is ready</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_MealReady" name="Receive notice that meal is in service hatch" messageRef="Msg_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_GuestOrTimeout" name="Guest at hatch or timeout?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GuestAtHatch" messageRef="Msg_GuestAtHatch"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E1" sourceRef="Start_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_EnterOrder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E5" sourceRef="Task_HandBuzzer" targetRef="Task_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E6" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="ReceiveTask_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E7" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_MealReady" targetRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E8" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E9" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitMerge" targetRef="EventGW_GuestOrTimeout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E10" sourceRef="EventGW_GuestOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E11" sourceRef="EventGW_GuestOrTimeout" targetRef="Timer_5Min"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E12" sourceRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch" targetRef="Task_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E13" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="End_MealHandedOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E14" sourceRef="Timer_5Min" targetRef="Task_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E15" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chef" name="Chef" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ChefOrder" name="New meal order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ChefOrder" messageRef="Msg_ChefOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInHatch" name="Place finished meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformEmployeeMealReady" name="Inform employee that meal is in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ChefDone" name="Meal ready"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C1" sourceRef="Start_ChefOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_PlaceInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C3" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInHatch" targetRef="Task_InformEmployeeMealReady"/>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RestaurantOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restaurant-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment made"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Buzzer" name="Buzzer handed over with information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Call" name="Guest called"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ArrivalAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MealHandover" name="Meal handed over"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RestaurantOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Restaurant" name="Restaurant" processRef="Process_Restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PlaceOrder" name="Order placed" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Payment made" sourceRef="Task_PayOrder" targetRef="Task_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Buzzer" name="Buzzer handed over" sourceRef="Task_PassBuzzer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Call" name="Guest called" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Catch_CallReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ArrivalAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch" sourceRef="Task_GoToHatch" targetRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MealHandover" name="Meal handed over" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveMeal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GuestHungry" name="Guest feels hungry and enters restaurant">
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from changing meal range">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PayOrder" name="Pay for order">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer with information" messageRef="Msg_Buzzer">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_Buzzer" name="Buzzer rings or called?">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CallReceived" name="Employee calls for guest">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CallReceived" messageRef="Msg_Call"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Hatch" name="Guest goes to hatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>G_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoToHatch" name="Go to service hatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveMeal" name="Receive meal at service hatch" messageRef="Msg_MealHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EatMeal" name="Eat meal">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>G_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MealEaten" name="Meal eaten">
      <bpmn:incoming>G_14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_1" sourceRef="Start_GuestHungry" targetRef="Task_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDish" targetRef="Task_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_3" sourceRef="Task_WaitTurn" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_4" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_PayOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_5" sourceRef="Task_PayOrder" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_6" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="EventGW_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_7" sourceRef="EventGW_Buzzer" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_8" sourceRef="EventGW_Buzzer" targetRef="Catch_CallReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_9" sourceRef="Catch_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_10" sourceRef="Catch_CallReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Hatch" targetRef="Task_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_12" sourceRef="Task_GoToHatch" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_13" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveMeal" targetRef="Task_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="G_14" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="End_MealEaten"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Restaurant" name="Restaurant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Restaurant">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Restaurant employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUpBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PassBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetOffBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Merge_Wait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventGW_Hatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_GuestAtHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Timer_5Min</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_MealHandedOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Chef" name="Chef">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceInHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformEmployeeReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Order placed by guest">
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterOrder" name="Enter order into POS system">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectPayment" name="Collect payment from guest">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PassBuzzer" name="Pass buzzer on to guest with information">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInHatch" name="Place finished meal in service hatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformEmployeeReady" name="Inform employee that meal is placed in service hatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Wait" name="Guest reaction pending">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>R_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_Hatch" name="Guest at hatch or 5 minutes elapsed?">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GuestAtHatch" messageRef="Msg_ArrivalAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_5Min" name="5 minutes elapsed">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_5Min">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallGuest" name="Call for guest">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>R_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_MealHandedOver" name="Meal handed over">
      <bpmn:incoming>R_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_1" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_EnterOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterOrder" targetRef="Task_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_3" sourceRef="Task_CollectPayment" targetRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_4" sourceRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer" targetRef="Task_PassBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_5" sourceRef="Task_PassBuzzer" targetRef="Task_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_6" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_7" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_PlaceInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_8" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInHatch" targetRef="Task_InformEmployeeReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_9" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployeeReady" targetRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_10" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Wait" targetRef="EventGW_Hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_12" sourceRef="EventGW_Hatch" targetRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_13" sourceRef="EventGW_Hatch" targetRef="Timer_5Min"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_14" sourceRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch" targetRef="Task_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_15" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="End_MealHandedOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_16" sourceRef="Timer_5Min" targetRef="Task_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="R_17" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Wait"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RestaurantOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restaurant-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer with information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ChefOrder" name="New meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MealReady" name="Meal placed in service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Call" name="Guest called"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ArrivalAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MealHandover" name="Meal handed over"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RestaurantOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Restaurant employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Chef" name="Chef" processRef="Process_Chef"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Start_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PayOrder" sourceRef="Task_PayOrder" targetRef="Task_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_HandOverBuzzer" sourceRef="Task_HandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InformChef" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Start_NewOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MealReadyNotice" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployee" targetRef="Catch_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SetOffBuzzer" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CallGuest" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Catch_CalledForGuest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ArrivalAtHatch" sourceRef="Task_GoToHatch" targetRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MealHandover" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Catch_MealHandedOver"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Hungry" name="Guest feels hungry and enters restaurant">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_G1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_TurnComes" name="It is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PayOrder" name="Pay for order"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BuzzerReceived" name="Buzzer received: "When the buzzer rings, your dinner is ready"">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BuzzerReceived" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerHandover"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_Guest" name="Buzzer or call?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CalledForGuest" name="Called for guest">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CalledForGuest" messageRef="Msg_Call"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Hatch_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoToHatch" name="Go to service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_MealHandedOver" name="Meal handed over at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MealHandedOver" messageRef="Msg_MealHandover"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Guest" name="Meal eaten"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G1" sourceRef="Start_Hungry" targetRef="Task_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDish" targetRef="Catch_TurnComes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G3" sourceRef="Catch_TurnComes" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G4" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_PayOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G5" sourceRef="Task_PayOrder" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G6" sourceRef="Catch_BuzzerReceived" targetRef="EventGW_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G7" sourceRef="EventGW_Guest" targetRef="Catch_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G8" sourceRef="EventGW_Guest" targetRef="Catch_CalledForGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G9" sourceRef="Catch_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Gateway_Hatch_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G10" sourceRef="Catch_CalledForGuest" targetRef="Gateway_Hatch_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G11" sourceRef="Gateway_Hatch_Merge" targetRef="Task_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G12" sourceRef="Task_GoToHatch" targetRef="Catch_MealHandedOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G13" sourceRef="Catch_MealHandedOver" targetRef="Task_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_G14" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="End_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Restaurant employee" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed by guest">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterOrder" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectPayment" name="Collect money from guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOverBuzzer" name="Pass buzzer on to guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_MealReady" name="Meal placed in service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MealReady" messageRef="Msg_MealReady"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repeat_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_Hatch" name="Guest at hatch or timeout?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GuestAtHatch" messageRef="Msg_ArrivalAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_5Min" name="5 minutes elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_5Min">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallGuest" name="Call for guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Meal" name="Meal handed over"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E1" sourceRef="Start_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_EnterOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E2" sourceRef="Task_EnterOrder" targetRef="Task_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E3" sourceRef="Task_CollectPayment" targetRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E4" sourceRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer" targetRef="Task_HandOverBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E5" sourceRef="Task_HandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Task_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E6" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Catch_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E7" sourceRef="Catch_MealReady" targetRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E8" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_Repeat_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E9" sourceRef="Gateway_Repeat_Merge" targetRef="EventGW_Hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E10" sourceRef="EventGW_Hatch" targetRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E11" sourceRef="EventGW_Hatch" targetRef="Timer_5Min"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E12" sourceRef="Timer_5Min" targetRef="Task_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E13" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_Repeat_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E14" sourceRef="Catch_GuestAtHatch" targetRef="Task_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_E15" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="End_Meal"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chef" name="Chef" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NewOrder" name="New meal order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NewOrder" messageRef="Msg_ChefOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee that meal is placed in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Chef" name="Meal placed in hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C1" sourceRef="Start_NewOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C2" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_PlaceInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C3" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInHatch" targetRef="Task_InformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_C4" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployee" targetRef="End_Chef"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
